property_summary: Invariant: Only the current owner can change owner via transferOwnership; the mutant removing the require allows a non-owner caller to change owner, so for some fuzzed newOwner and caller the owner after transfer differs between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Remove the require check from onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call guarded functions and thus permitting transferOwnership to set owner to _newOwner when called by non-owner.
